summary: This paper provides an algebraically tight, first-principles resolution of all three empirical anomalies reported for multi-head QNNs inside Qwen3-30B-A3B [1]. Every closed-form identity—the O(n_q L) SO(3) Bloch surrogate, odd-parity mixer collapse, exact Heisenberg-picture R_zz leakage laws across all 87 open-chain pool observables, conditional-variance token-mixing floor, and 90.22% classical readout parameter dominance—is derived cleanly and verified line by line without error. The scope of the accompanying Lean 4.36.0 and zero-float Q[i] verification layers is delineated transparently.
strengths: Complete, sign-accurate Heisenberg-picture R_zz leakage laws (Eqs. 6-11) covering all 87 non-identity open-chain local pool observables, exactly accounting for the 28/87 = 32.18% single-layer expected loss and 75% interior transverse loss at n_q = 8.
Exact SO(3) Bloch-sphere surrogate (Theorem 1) establishing 64/3x state compression at n_q = 8 and O(n_q L) classical evaluation for all 1- and 2-qubit pool observables when entanglers vanish.

Sharp synthesis of odd-parity mixer orthogonality (Theorem 2a), the conditional-expectation Pythagorean token-mixing barrier (Theorem 3a), and universal readout parameter dominance for d_h >= 14 (Theorem 3b), yielding concrete architectural prescriptions in Remark 1.

Transparent and honest delineation between properties formally proved in the zero-axiom Lean 4.36.0 kernel (thm01-thm20) and continuous/general-n_q proofs in Sections 2-4 supplemented by exact Q[i] certificates.
weaknesses: Theorem 2(a) establishes odd-parity orthogonality under a centrally symmetric input law P(x) = P(-x) and unshifted M_2 tanh(M_1 x); empirical asymmetry of real LLM Layer 1 activations or any asymmetric offset in external rescaling buffers is not directly measured.

The multi-layer direct-channel survival decay (cos^2 gamma)^L factor in Theorem 2(c) omits Z-branching and weight->=3 back-scattering, though this approximation is explicitly disclosed and supplemented by exact n_q = 4, L = 2 Q[i] statevector purity calculations in Figure 2(b).

Individual mathematical ingredients (SU(2) -> SO(3) double cover, Pauli weight spreading, L^2 conditional expectation) are classical, so novelty lies in their exact closed-form synthesis for the multi-head QNN LLM architecture.
